name: Buru x Karu ~Sensei! Kakugoshite ne~
original_name: ぶる×かる ～先生！カクゴしてね～
source:
Four friends Haruka, Natsuo, Akina, and Fuyuki are in the volleyball club at school. They love bloomers more than volleyball! One day a new teacher Daisuke-sensei becomes their new volleyball coach. Afraid that he'll ban their favorite bloomers they come up with a plan. They'll tempt him with their bodies and when he crosses the line they'll have him fired!

But their plan has a flaw. Sex feels amazing!
translation:
Haruka、Natsuo、Akina和Fuyuki四个朋友是学校排球部的成员。比起排球，他们更喜欢灯笼裤！有一天，一位新老师大辅老师成为了他们的新排球教练。由于担心他会禁止他们最喜欢的灯笼裤，他们想出了一个计划。他们会用身体诱惑他，当他越界时，他们就会解雇他！

但他们的计划有一个缺陷。性爱感觉棒极了！
